payload: No -- CAD Sketcher for Blender is not dead or abandoned; development moved off the main branch to an active 'SLVS package' branch (updated 4 days before recording) where PR #504 has been migrating the add-on from the unofficial to the official SolverSpace Python solver package since March 6. The main branch looks stalled, which is why people worried, but the work is ongoing -- just slower because it is volunteer/open-source rather than a full-time commercial team.

tease.question: Is CAD Sketcher for Blender dead -- has development stopped and the package been abandoned?
tease.answer: No. The main GitHub branch looks quiet, but an active 'SLVS package' branch (updated 4 days ago) and PR #504 show continuous work since March 6 migrating to the official SolverSpace Python package; it is alive but moving at open-source/volunteer speed.

notes: Evidence cited: GitHub main branch appears stalled, but the 'SLVS package' branch shows recent commits and PR #504 documents extensive work from March 6 to ~4 days before recording.
Closing call to action: support the project via code, testing, bug reports, documentation, or Patreon/donations; new users encouraged to try it, existing users to be patient.
